product_metadata.title: Electric Lunch Box for Car and Home 110V & 12V 40W - Removable Stainless Steel Portable Food Grade Material Warmer Heater - with 2 in 1 Fork & Spoon (Green)
features: 【Food Grade Mateial】Lunch Box is made of food grade PP material and stainless steel, totally nontoxic and healthy. Give you a healthy lunch.

【Removable & Leak Proofing】The stainless steel container is removable, therefore it is very easy to clean. included a removable plastic compartment. In addition, our lunch box adds a leak-proof seal ring design, it improves the defect of food leakage. Prevent fluid leakage in sloshing car environments.

【Car and Home Dual Use】 12V car /Truck 24V 2-in-1 use adapter and 110V home use adapter are included. With this HEIGE dual use food warmer, you can heat your meal at school, office, taxi, Truck,home or during travle.

【Portable】 The lunch warmer is very convenient to take your meal with you. When you need to use it, insert it into the car charging jack or the home 110V socket, and wait 30 to 45 minutes to heat the food.
【Capacity】This food warmer is high temperature resistance, and also very durable. Size: 9.3 x 6.5 x 4.2 inch, Capacity: 1.5L. Also, we have included an 2 in 1 Fork & Spoon for free.
description: HEIGE Car and Home Dual Use Portable Food Warmer Gives You a Healthy Lunch Wherever You Are.

Material: Food grade PP material & 304 stainless steel, very safe. Product Size: 9.26 x 6.5 x 4.13 inch Double Voltage- Support both car use 12V/24V + home use 110V Removable Container - It is easy to Clean and Fill.

1. Please put the cooked food into the rice container and the dishes container. 2. Please fasten the lip. 3. Open the socket stopper, insert the power cord. 4. When the indicator light is on , heating is started.

*Heating time depends on the amount of rice, vegetables,and the indoor temperature.  *When the food get from the fridge ,the heating time should be extension appropriate. *The exhaust lid must be opened before heating to prevent the steam pressure inside the lunch box will cause the product deform and can not be used normally.
* If the food has been set aside for a long time, it is suggested to add some water into the food and then plug in to heat  so that the food would become softer.
- 1 x Electric Heating Lunch Box - 1 x Spoon  - 1 x Stainless Steel 2-in-1 Fork & Spoon - 1 x 12V/24V Car-use charging cable - 1 x 110V Home-use charging cable - 1 x Manual
